name: onion-two-designs
title: Two ways to reach a vendor's files
subtitle: Illustrative. One search call, outermost layer first; orange chips show where the vendor token is readable

onions.label: A. Proxy to the vendor's MCP server
onions.sublabel: We run one layer; the vendor runs the rest
onions.verdict: 4 layers. The vendor's server sees the token, as it must.

layers.title: Credential proxy
layers.does: Checks the caller, adds the vendor token

layers.title: Vendor MCP server
layers.does: Turns the tool call into API calls

onions.label: B. Our code, served as MCP
onions.sublabel: We run three layers, including the sandbox
onions.verdict: 5 layers. Only our host sees the token.

layers.title: Credential proxy
layers.does: Checks the caller, picks the function

layers.title: Function host
layers.does: Adds the token to outbound requests
